violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of spatulas were not observed sanitized: at the 3-compartment sinks. An employee was observed cleaned two stainless steel spatulas at this sink, and carried them away without sanitizing them.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION. The CFM was advised to retrain employees properly on how and when to sanitize utensils and other food contact surfaces.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: chicken tenders were observed holding at inadequate temperatures, at the holding bin. Observed temperatures were as follows: 128, 126, 127, 126.5F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control as specified under 3-501.19. CORRECTED, The tenders were discarded during the inspection.

violations.title: Jewelry
violations.observation: Employees observed wearing jewelry on their arms and hands while preparing food. A female employee was observed wearing bracelets while she was handling food on the cook-line.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall limit their jewelry to a plain wedding ring while preparing food. Food employees may not wear bracelets, watches, etc. because they can inhibit proper hand washing. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION. Employee removed the jewelry from her hands.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The faucet at the hand washing sink in the women’s restroom is very loose and in need of repair. This faucet needs to be secure in place.
violations.corrective_action: Properly secure faucet at this sink for proper operation.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage Prohibited in Garbage Rooms
violations.observation: Food storage in garbage rooms. Racks of buns observed stored next to trash containers inside the dry storage room .
violations.corrective_action: Food may not be stored next top trash containers and mop buckets, to prevent contamination. CDI-CFE relocated the trash containers and the mop bucket away from food and single service utensils, during the inspection.
